name: AMD Ryzen™ AI 9 365 (host of Radeon 880M iGPU) — official product page
notes: AMD product page lists LPDDR5X-8000 max memory speed, 2 channels, but publishes no iGPU bandwidth figure. 128 GB/s is derived (8000 MT/s x 16 B). Capacity is not applicable: 880M is an integrated GPU sharing host memory (configurable carve-out), so memory_gb is null rather than a fixed device capacity.
